title: Test purchase analysis, version 1.0
description: The analyst's report as data. One object per check-item of the worksheet, with the source and the evidence in typed fields instead of a line of prose. The readable report is produced from this file; nothing is parsed back out of prose. Test purchase methodology for AI agents - Sergei Ponomarev - aibusiness.vc

test_did_not_take_place.description: filled only where the interaction was broken off by a technical failure of the external environment: then there is no matrix

matrix.description: the twelve scores, in the order of the positions

positions.description: one entry per position: the score, whether the primary evidence was sufficient, and the observed cause where there is evidence for one

case.description: mandatory for every score of +2 and -3

check_items.description: one entry per check-item of the worksheet; codes are unique

receipt_against_the_record.description: the comparison of the AI Receipt with the transcript and the log, in prose: it belongs to the report, not to the scoring

quote.description: something that was said: a message of this run and the words themselves, verbatim, up to fifteen words

event.description: something that was done: a journal event of this run, its operation and its status

bounded_absence.description: something forbidden that is not there: the messages that were examined, and what is absent from them. An absence cannot be quoted

examined.description: the message identifiers examined, or the two ends of the range

comparison.description: consistency, completeness or agreement across sources: two or more sources, and what was compared with what

sources.description: identifiers of this run (M-..., E-..., a row of the technical record such as 2.15.6) or a named primary source: env, worksheet, policy, passport, receipt form, journal, transcript, section I, section II, reference state
